newsitem.title: INDIA: Fire destroys bikes at India's Tube unit.
newsitem.headline: Fire destroys bikes at India's Tube unit.

text.p: A fire destroyed 50,000 bicycles in a factory belonging to a unit of Tube Investments of India Ltd, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said on Thursday.
The news agency said the fire broke out on Wednesday night in the export division of TI Cycles, a subsidiary of Tube Investments, outside the capital of the southern state of Tamil Nadu, Madras.
No one was injured in the fire, it said.
The bicycles, in cardboard boxes, were to be exported on Thursday, PTI said.
An official of Tube Investments in New Delhi had no information on the fire. Officials of TI Cycles in Tamil Nadu could not be reached for comment.
